entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Exams are finally over...[n]I'm so exhausted...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can get back to actually sleepin'[n]in peace...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh. You must have been studying[n]pretty hard if it kept you up at night.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nah, I was up playin' video games.[n]Slackin' off is just too much fun...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know, right!? I kept cleaning my room[n]instead of studying! It might even be[n]TOO clean now...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You two are perfect exemplars of what[n]escapism can mean.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *sigh* And I can only imagine what the[n]end result will be.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whatever, it's over with now. Who cares[n]about that anymore!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's real important is the Phantom[n]Thieves' popularity! Ain't it amazin'!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It kinda feels like our time's finally here!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have even heard people excitedly[n]speculating about our next target.[n]We will have to choose carefully.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's no need to hurry. We should[n]spend some time thinking it over.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hold up, the most important thing now[n]is our celebration party!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I hope you guys didn't forget. It's the[n]fireworks festival on the 18th.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess we're good meetin' up in Shibuya,[n]yeah? Let's say... 5 pm!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You sure are on top of THESE kinds[n]of things...
